messages.message: We talked about a docker solution for isolation. I wonder if that is feasible. We have much more control over the operating env.

I think we can execute an agent with exec and that starts it's on internal app server. I think we would have to ensure logs are retained and anything else our metrics uses for example. Not sure the scope of such a change or if the current boundaries make it easier or harder.
what about retaining for review and builder, retaining for rereview?
I guess we could just keep the docker session running until we are done
perfect. perhaps we should explore this
